name: zones_t24_extended_street
description: Conformance test 24 (extended street, §7.11). Street (12, 5..10) ends inside the zone rect; zone 4 on x 10..15, z 10..13 except (12,10) (the street end); SetOptions(0, 1, 0). ExtendAsStreets(kind 3): (12,10) connects only on facing side 0 -> DrawStreet((12,10)->(12,13), perCell 0); the start cell (12,10) is not in R (it holds a network), so the run is (12,11)..(12,13) -> Place(12,11,12,13), which lays a street down the rest of column 12. LayInJogStreets draws nothing ((12,9) connects on two sides, not a dead end). SubdivideTheZone then splits the region at the street column x = 12 into two components, in first-cell order: x 10..11 then x 13..15. First component S = {2, 120, 2, 4}, D = 1, Q = 2, flag 1 -> lots (10,12)-(11,13) f1 and (10,10)-(11,11) f1 (rows from the high side, full-depth override). Second component S = {3, 4, 3, 120}, D = 3, Q = 2 -> lots (13,12)-(15,13) f3 and (13,10)-(15,11) f3.
